title: Writing to a large image file
statement: An image layer contains a 2 GB file /data/big.db. The container's storage uses overlay (the overlay2 driver or the containerd overlayfs snapshotter). A process in the container opens the file for writing and changes 10 bytes. What happens?
choices: Only the 10 changed bytes are stored in the container's writable layer as a block diff
The write fails because image layers are read-only
The whole file is copied up into the container's writable layer first, then modified there
The change is written into the image layer and is visible to every container using that image
